method_note: Read lines 1-1260 and targeted greps of the rest of the target file. Chose claims by risk: repository metadata (licence, archived, push, release dates), spec versions and statuses, DSP/DCP endpoint paths, status codes, media/context URLs and schema facts, Catena-X standard versions and mandated model versions, DTR OpenAPI paths, Tractus-X EDC API paths, DOIs, and the existing_check claims about engine behaviour (checked in src/dppce and by re-running the jsonschema metaschema check on the DPP 7.0.0 schema). Repo metadata via read-only gh api; spec text via gh raw file reads at the stated tags; DOIs via Crossref. EUR-Lex returned empty bodies again, so legal citations are not_confirmed. No live systems were contacted.

rule5_findings.problem: Title '(dataspace terminology, as named in DSP release notes)' adds a subject description for an ISO/IEC document. The release note says only 'align dataspace definitions with ISO/IEC FDIS 20151-1' and the file itself says the title was not confirmed. Mild rule 5 and rule 6 risk.
rule5_findings.fix: Title 'ISO/IEC FDIS 20151-1 (title not confirmed)'; keep number, stage and the release-note URL only.

rule5_findings.problem: States that release notes mention a 'JTC 1 PAS submission'. The 2025-1-err2 release note contains only the FDIS 20151-1 terminology line, so the PAS statement is not supported by the cited tag.
rule5_findings.fix: Delete the PAS sentence or cite the release page where it appears.

rule5_findings.problem: No paraphrase of the standards found. Entries name the number and edition taken from a CX-0010 reference list and say the algorithm is not described. Acceptable; the editions are unverified at ISO.
rule5_findings.fix: Keep as bibliographic only; add 'edition per CX-0010 reference list, not checked at ISO'.

missed_items.fact: The docs/ (next, preview) copy of CX-0143 is titled v1.5.0, so the Titan v1.4.0 mandate may change in the next release train. The file only mentions 1.4.0 and the overview's 1.2.0.

catenax-eV hosts a 'sig-cx-test-suite' repository (issues from CX Test Suite go-live and beta) and a 'cx-odrl-profile' repository (Catena-X ODRL profile and contract modules, pushed 2026-06-26). Both are relevant reusable suites and the likely open source of the policy schema pinned for the cx-0152 rule pack.
sldt-discovery-finder and sldt-bpn-discovery both carry tags v0.6.0 and v0.6.1 that are newer than the latest GitHub releases (0.5.1 and 0.6.0). Pin by tag, not by 'latest release'.
admin-shell-io/smt-semantic-models has release V1.1.3 published 2026-10-15; the file records only metadata for the repo and the 1.0.x model versions from CX-0160.

protocol-version-schema.json types 'version' as any string plus a documented enum of 0.8, 2024-1 and 2025-1, so Catena-X's 'v0.8' key validates against the schema even though it is not in the enum; a rule pack must test the 'v0.8' versus '0.8' difference itself.

A decision record dated 2026-08-10 ('refresh token retire on acknowledgement') exists in tractusx-edc 0.13.0 and may change EDR refresh behaviour that a test oracle would rely on; the file lists only the 2025-02-12 and 2026-01-07 records.
A decision record dated 2026-01-06 covers retrieval of the connector service from the DID document; relevant to the DID-based discovery step in the end-to-end flow.

overall: The file is highly reliable on technical facts. Every repository metadata value, release date, licence and archived flag that I rechecked matched, and every DSP, DCP, Catena-X, DTR and Tractus-X EDC endpoint, status code, media or context URL, and schema property that I rechecked matched the source at the stated tag. The engine-mapping claims also hold: I confirmed the reason codes and refusal statuses in src/dppce, and I reproduced the draft-04 schema failure with the metaschema check. Weak points: all EU article numbers are unverified because EUR-Lex returned empty pages, one version claim (digitalTwinType 'since' 1.4.0) is not supported by the changelog, the Deloitte and SQS CAB claim rests on a search excerpt, and two source descriptions for the ISO/IEC FDIS 20151-1 entry add unsupported detail. No rule 5 breach (no paraphrase of protected standards text) was found. Smaller omissions: preview CX-0143 v1.5.0, newer v0.6.1 tags, and the Catena-X test-suite repository.
